**Feature Summary**
A clear and concise description of what the feature achieves.

**Target User Persona**
- [ ] School Administrator / Transport Manager
- [ ] Bus Driver
- [ ] Parent / Student

**Scope Verification (Anti-Pattern Check)**
- [ ] Does this maintain the WhatsApp-first parent model?
- [ ] Does this avoid unnecessary hardware bloat (CCTV/RFID/Biometrics)?
- [ ] Does this respect school tenant isolation?

**Proposed Domain / Architecture Changes**
Describe schema, API, or UI modifications needed.
